name: Nasika Churna

sections.reference_sahasrayoga_churna_prakarana_6: Nasika Churna is an Ayurvedic medicine which is available in herbal powder form. It is an effective treatment for the various problems like chronic rhinitis, headache, bad breath etc.
sections.ingredients:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Amla – Emblica officinalis / Phyllanthus emblica 
 Cumin seed – Cuminum cyminum 
 Mayurpiccha Kanda – Peocock tail 
 Jatiphala – Nutmeg (fruit) – Myristica fragrans 
 Jatipatra – Nutmeg (leaf) – Myristica fragrans 
 Balaka – Pavonia odorata 
 Khus Khus – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Amaya – Saussurea lappa 
 Ginger (rhizome) – Zingiber officinalis 
 Sandalwood – Santalum album 
 Dhupa Patra 
 Lemon juice for grinding 
 Coconut water for grinding 
 Rose water – for grinding 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Dhupika Sara 
 Mrigamada – Musk 

 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the above mentioned ingredients, make fine powder. Mix well to form the nasika churna.
sections.dosage: It is administered via nasal route.
sections.indications:
Chronic rhinitis 
 Allergic respiratory conditions 
 Bad breath 
 Upper respiratory tract infections 
 Migraine 
 Sinusitis 
 Head tremors
sections.side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine is strictly avoided. Take this only under medical supervision. 
 This medicine should be taken in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause vomiting. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 

 Note – This medicine is to be used strictly under medical supervision in the case of diabetic, hypertensive patients, cardiac patients, obese people, pregnant ladies, lactating mothers and children. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Nasika Churna 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga Churna Prakarana 64 
 Nasika Churna is an Ayurvedic medicine which is available in herbal powder form. It is an effective treatment for the various problems like chronic rhinitis, headache, bad breath etc. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Amla – Emblica officinalis / Phyllanthus emblica 
 Cumin seed – Cuminum cyminum 
 Mayurpiccha Kanda – Peocock tail 
 Jatiphala – Nutmeg (fruit) – Myristica fragrans 
 Jatipatra – Nutmeg (leaf) – Myristica fragrans 
 Balaka – Pavonia odorata 
 Khus Khus – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Amaya – Saussurea lappa 
 Ginger (rhizome) – Zingiber officinalis 
 Sandalwood – Santalum album 
 Dhupa Patra 
 Lemon juice for grinding 
 Coconut water for grinding 
 Rose water – for grinding 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Dhupika Sara 
 Mrigamada – Musk 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the above mentioned ingredients, make fine powder. Mix well to form the nasika churna. 
 Dosage 
 It is administered via nasal route. 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic rhinitis 
 Allergic respiratory conditions 
 Bad breath 
 Upper respiratory tract infections 
 Migraine 
 Sinusitis 
 Head tremors 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine is strictly avoided. Take this only under medical supervision. 
 This medicine should be taken in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause vomiting. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 
 Note – This medicine is to be used strictly under medical supervision in the case of diabetic, hypertensive patients, cardiac patients, obese people, pregnant ladies, lactating mothers and children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
